typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT          A.[TABLE_SOURCE] AS TABLE_SOURCE       ,A.[SalesTypeCd] AS SalesTypeCd       ,A.[Scenario] AS Scenario       ,A.[FYear_Id] AS FYear_Id       ,A.[BusinessDay_Dt] AS BusinessDay_Dt       ,A.[Businessunit_cd] AS Businessunit_Cd       ,A.[Loc_Id] AS Loc_Id       ,A.[Comp_Id] AS Comp_Id       ,A.[Dept_Id] AS Dept_Id       ,A.[ItemSku_Num] AS ItemSku_Num       ,A.[Customer_Account_Id] AS Customer_Account_Id       ,A.[Currency]  AS Currency       ,A.[Sales] AS Sales       ,A.[Cost] AS Cost       ,A.[Program_USD_Amt] AS Program_USD_Amt       ,A.[Comments] AS Comments        FROM [BIFeeds].[dbo].[WORK_FINANCE_PLAN]A   WHERE        (        A.[IsScenario_valid]			= \'Y\' AND        A.[IsFYear_IdNumeric]		= \'Y\' AND        A.[IsBusinessDay_DtNumeric]	= \'Y\' AND        A.[IsSalesNumeric]         	= \'Y\' AND        A.[IsCostNumeric]			= \'Y\' AND        A.[IsProgram_USD_AmtNumeric]	= \'Y\' AND        A.IsDept_IdNumeric           = \'Y\' AND        A.IsCustomer_Account_IdNumeric = \'Y\'        )',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Loc_Id as string,
		ItemSku_Num as string,
		Comments as string,
		Businessunit_Cd as string,
		TABLE_SOURCE as string,
		Cost as string,
		Scenario as string,
		Program_USD_Amt as string,
		Sales as string,
		Comp_Id as string,
		Dept_Id as string,
		FYear_Id as string,
		BusinessDay_Dt as string,
		Customer_Account_Id as string,
		SalesTypeCd as string,
		Currency as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Loc_Id,
		ItemSku_Num,
		Comments,
		Businessunit_Cd,
		TABLE_SOURCE,
		Cost,
		Scenario,
		Program_USD_Amt,
		Sales,
		Comp_Id,
		Dept_Id,
		FYear_Id,
		BusinessDay_Dt,
		Customer_Account_Id,
		SalesTypeCd,
		Currency)) ~> FlatFileDestination
